scope: USB bounded best-effort AP17/SWITCH18 source candidate, transport, fixed policy, kernel scaffold, manual helper, experimental image integration
verified_properties: Exact dodge identity; default-disabled0400 bool opt-in and root0600 fixed start/restore commands only; no arbitrary property/value API.
Normal boot and default helper never automatically mutate firmware; opt-in flag is added only to targets experimental image builder, manifest auto-start=false.
Legacy owner/type/opcode/property/length/return matching; SET value is not treated as echo; exact GET readback required.
Only first matched callback owns completion; late optional GET and SET responses quarantined; notifications remain responsive.
Send error, timeout and service loss poison optional transport without retry; unknown cleanup stays terminal.
Exact0/0 baseline before mutation;120s delayed restore armed with awake hold before first dirty-before-SET; boottime deadline blocks late enabling.
Built-in config plus MODULE store rejection and boot atomic latch prevent rebind reacquisition.
AP1 then SW1, each GET checked plus final pair; rollback owned SW0 then AP0, each GET checked plus final0/0 pair; dirty cleared only after final pair success.
Watchdog and remove do not retry UNKNOWN or change REFUSED to RESTORED; idle cleanup sends nothing.
Remove sets stopping, drains delayed and enable work without holding worker mutex, restores before devm GLINK release; PDR/enable guards stop requeue.
Helper requires protected RAM marker, root and exact flags; lease wait default/max45, work80 reserve, storage only with32s remaining; start20s restore15s status3s subprocess budgets.

Helper records attempted before start command and nested finally restores firmware even when host/device role operations fail; cleanup requires used terminal clean receipt, idle rebind and UNKNOWN rejected.
No VBUS-regulator, TypeC policy, GPIO, voltage/current or OEM protocol fallback writes added.
review_findings_resolved: SET response echo/boolean assumption split from GET semantics.
First-response callback ownership prevents duplicate result overwrite.
UNKNOWN retry and REFUSED-state corruption stopped at policy level.
Boottime+awake protection and built-in boot latch added.
Lifecycle drain ordering and enable/PDR stopping checks added.
Accidental bare return additions to int property getters removed; original getters preserved.
Final pair readback catches firmware coupling after last mutation.
Signed sysfs return restored to explicit error path.
Python command budgets aligned with multiple1s transactions; wait/work/storage budgets reserve rollback time.
Idle/rebind receipt no longer accepted as verified cleanup after attempt.
mock_test_limits: Mock locks validate local call ordering, not real-kernel race freedom, scheduler latency, transport availability or actual firmware responses.
No transaction ID exists; arbitrarily delayed duplicated same-tuple successful replies remain a protocol assumption. GET validation reduces ACK ambiguity but is not cryptographic freshness.
No full image/kernel build was performed by reviewer; parent must complete Actions compile, exact image readback and source binding.
Independent extracted-vendor SET validator demonstrated source behavior only; it did not discover actual phone SET reply contents.
runtime_and_admission_limits: 120s delayed worker is best effort, not a hard wall-clock restoration guarantee; mutex/send/kernel hang or GLINK loss may prevent restore.
SET can apply before ACK loss; poison then deliberately prevents ambiguous retry. UNKNOWN is not proof of restored firmware.
RAM boot does not establish firmware property nonpersistence; no vendor lease TTL, reset-on-reboot or saved-gate restore guarantee found.
Active reboot bypasses devres removal. Future joint runner must require verified restore before ordinary Android return and define explicit UNKNOWN recovery admission.
Monotonic work budget reserves time conservatively; synchronous sysfs/kernel operations and inventory are not guaranteed hard host-timeout bounds.
Policy gates do not establish electrical supply, TypeC partner, USB enumeration or real storage I/O. No physical USB success is claimed.
Source publication/build only. A fresh exact source/image/runner-bound independent review and active owner window are required for any phone execution; existing consumed ledgers remain consumed.
recommendation: Accept frozen sources for offline build and publication as explicitly experimental best-effort lease. Do not infer phone execution authorization or hardware acceptance.
